messages:
maya: Heads-up — canary in eu-west shows sustained p95 regression for ~6m. Proposing a targeted fallback for EU dedicated traffic (not global). Suggest start in 5m.

deploy-bot: canary-check: p95=410ms (baseline 210), error_rate=1.8%, anomaly=4.0. Recommendation: consider partial rollback; needs human confirmation.

raj: are the errors 5xx or model-quality? last eval showed minor token split differences.

olivia: checked traces: ~55% transient 502s from kv-cache path, the rest are 429s from aggressive batching. No content-quality failures detected.

maya: sounds infra-related. Plan: shift 10% of eu-dedicated pool back to v2.15, leave hosted/global on v2.16. Manual exec to avoid noisy global churn.

samir: +1. We'll pin reserved EU tenants to v2.15. Keep hosted traffic on v2.16.

elaine: CS heads-up: some dedicated EU customers may see brief reconnects. @tess-ops can you prep a short customer note and timeline?

tess-ops: drafting. Proposed window: start at T+5m, gradual 1%->10% over 4m, observe 10m, then decide. Short message: "Targeted rollback to improve latency; brief retries possible; no model content changes."

maya: agree on manual. deploy-bot automation shouldn't auto-rollback across segments here.

deploy-bot: rollback preview:
```
/deploy rollback --region eu-west-1 --pool dedicated-eu --to v2.15 --slice 10% --strategy gradual(step=1%,interval=60s)
```

maya: executing in 2m. Ownership: @raj metrics, @samir execute, @tess-ops CS, I'll update release notes.

samir: issuing manual rollback now.

deploy-bot: accepted. Progressing: 1% -> 2% -> 5% -> 10% over 4m. Will report updates.

deploy-bot: 2% applied. p95 eu-west -> 340ms.

raj: p95 2%->310ms, 5xx ~1.5%. kv-cache miss rate decreasing.

deploy-bot: 5% -> 10% done. p95 eu-west stabilized at 230ms, errors 0.7%.

olivia: quick regression checks on outputs OK.

maya: hold at 10% for 10m to validate. If stable, consider 25% but want to avoid flipping dedicated endpoints rapidly.

samir: holding. If metrics good for 10m we'll increment carefully.

tess-ops: CS note queued to affected accounts; internal #customers note ready to post in 10m.

elaine: tagging compliance: @legal-bot log audit entry for change: region=eu-west, pool=dedicated-eu, rolled back to v2.15 due to latency spike.

legal-bot: audit recorded (ID: audit-2026-0458).

maya: postmortem action items: correlate kernel flag flip with kv-cache behavior, add canary rate-limiter tuning, teach deploy-bot to surface infra vs model anomalies.

raj: will attach graphs and timelines to the RCA draft.

samir: after stabilization let's pin dedicated eu to v2.15 for this release window and plan a controlled roll-forward after kernel fix.

maya: noted. I'll add a short internal release-note update with owner and timeline.

deploy-bot: monitoring window started (10m). Will post final status.

deploy-bot: monitoring complete. Result: stable with partial rollback (10% dedicated-eu pinned to v2.15).

maya: closing thread. Next: ops RCA, kernel flag revert scheduling, CS outbound done. Thanks all.

tess-ops: sent CS notes. Closing comms loop. :white_check_mark:
